versions.subject: Rule: Scheduled task creation
versions.detection:
selection:
    EventID: 1
    Image: '*\schtasks.exe'
    CommandLine: '* /create *'
filter:
    User: 'NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM'
condition: selection and not filter
versions.spl: EventID=1 Image="*\\schtasks.exe" CommandLine="* /create *" NOT User="NT AUTHORITY\\SYSTEM"
